title: RSAA PhD Scholarships (2026/27 round) for international applicants
institution: Research School of Astronomy and Astrophysics (RSAA), The Australian National University
about: PhD scholarship round at ANU's Research School of Astronomy and Astrophysics for international applicants. Applications are due 15 November 2026 as one combined PDF, with three reference letters within a week; contacting faculty about projects beforehand is encouraged. Interviews expected February 2027.
requirements: Single combined PDF application emailed to the RSAA international address by 15 November 2026
Three letters of reference, arriving no later than one week after the deadline
ANU English requirements must be met by successful applicants (not by the deadline)
